finding: CRITICAL-1: evidence loop disconnected in real host wiring
rootCause: wire.ts attributionOrAudit sets modelId to the full qualified model string ('b-ai/glm-5.3-flash'); evaluation-store candidateKey prepends providerId again → double-qualified keys. evidence-snapshot parseCandidateId splits the engine candidateId ('b-ai/glm-5.3-flash#high') into providerId='b-ai', modelId='glm-5.3-flash' → single-qualified lookup keys. Keys never match.
analysis: Store keys carry double provider prefix (b-ai/b-ai/...); engine lookups use single prefix. providersFromEvidenceStore returns null for every quality/segment lookup → all dimensions UNKNOWN → all candidates UNPROVEN → only D-COLD ladder head selected. Evidence never reaches the scorer. Closed-loop tests pass because test helpers construct exec() with unqualified modelId ('glm-5.3-flash'), bypassing wire.ts, and closed-loop tests call store.record/recordExecution directly instead of the wire → store path.
